ageGate.title: First, a quick confirmation
ageGate.body: WeCare's guidance and any medical review relate to prescription medicine, which is only available to adults.
ageGate.checkbox: I confirm that I am 18 years or older.
ageGate.dobNote: Used only to confirm you're old enough to continue. It stays on this device and isn't attached to your name.
ageGate.dobTooYoung: The date of birth you entered shows you're under 18. WeCare's assessment and medical review are only available to adults.
ageGate.under: If you are under 18, please speak with a parent, guardian or your doctor.

start.title: Your assessment
start.intro: Six short questions about how you feel (about 60 to 90 seconds). This is not a medical form, no documents needed, and you can change any answer before you finish.
start.privacyNote: Your answers are private and secure.
start.selectAndPrivacy: Choose an option to continue. Your answers are private and secure.

phase.leadInNote: One quick delivery check, then your questions.

postcode.heading: Where should we deliver?
postcode.sub: We'll check we cover your area. Takes a second.

exclusion.heading: A few things your medical reviewer needs to know
exclusion.sub: Please answer the first two questions. They go to your medical reviewer.

pregnancy.q: Are you pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning to become pregnant?

recentSupply.q: In the last 30 days, have you received 100 g or more of cannabis on prescription?

conditions.q: Do any of these apply to you?
conditions.allergy: Known allergy to cannabis, THC or CBD

exclusion.flaggedNote: Thanks. Your medical reviewer will go through these with you before anything is prescribed.
exclusion.requiredPrompt: Answer the first two questions to continue.

q1.title: What do you need help with today?

q2.title: How often does this affect you?

hints.cbd: Over-the-counter CBD, e.g. drops or capsules

hints.vape: Inhaled as vapour from a pen or device

q6.title: What type of support do you prefer?
q6.note: New to this? Choose “Not sure” and your doctor confirms the right format either way.

hints.oil: Drops taken by mouth, the usual gentle starting format
hints.vape: Inhaled as vapour from a pen or device
hints.guidance: We’ll recommend a format for you

result.title: Your recommended solution is ready.
result.intro: Based on your answers, WeCare matched you with the most suitable support option.
result.gentleNudge: We start gentle with a lower-THC solution, usually an oil for controlled dosing. You can adjust it later with your doctor.
result.disclaimer: This recommendation is based on your answers and wellness preferences. It does not replace medical advice.
result.reviewRequiredNote: Medical cannabis is prescription-only. Your assessment is reviewed by a doctor; a prescription is issued only if it is medically appropriate.

explanations.sleep: Based on your sleep answers, we start with an evening support solution that tends to be calming. A stronger option is available if you need to step up.
explanations.pain: Based on your answers, we start with a body comfort solution for daily support. A stronger option is available as an advanced step.
explanations.stressAnxiety: Based on your answers, we start with a daily balance solution for a calmer routine. A stronger option is available if you need to step up.
explanations.migraine: Based on your answers, we start with head tension support built around daily balance. A second option is available depending on how it feels.

view.title: View your recommended Solution
view.body: See what was matched and why, then continue to medical review.

review.title: Medical review
review.body: A doctor checks that it is suitable for you. A prescription is issued only if appropriate.

delivery.title: Order & delivery
delivery.body: Once approved, choose your amount and a licensed pharmacy ships it discreetly to your door.

result.altStrongerHint: Another matched option you can explore.
result.frequencyNote: You told us this affects you {{frequency}}. That's noted for your medical review.
result.formatPreferenceNote: You mentioned you'd prefer {{format}}. Your doctor confirms the right format for you. For most people starting out, that's an oil.
result.submitReviewCta: Submit my assessment for medical review
result.exclusionNote: Your reviewer will also go through the health checks you completed.

review.heading: Your medical review
review.reassure: You don't need to stay on this page. We'll email you as soon as the status changes.
review.notGuaranteed: A prescription is issued only if it is medically appropriate. It is not guaranteed.

steps.a: Your assessment is sent to a licensed medical professional.
steps.b: The doctor reviews it and may ask for more information.
steps.c: You're notified of the outcome by email.
steps.d: If approved, a licensed pharmacy prepares and ships your order.

inReview.label: In review
inReview.body: A clinician is reviewing your case.

infoRequired.label: More info needed
infoRequired.body: We may contact you for more details.

approved.label: Approved
approved.body: You'll be notified once approved, then a licensed pharmacy prepares your order.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.title: Assessment submitted
submitted.body: Your assessment has been sent for medical review.

inReview.label: In medical review
inReview.title: A doctor is reviewing your assessment
inReview.body: A licensed medical professional is reviewing your answers.

infoRequired.label: Information needed
infoRequired.title: The doctor needs a bit more information
infoRequired.body: Please check your email. The reviewing doctor has asked for additional details before they can continue.

approved.label: Approved
approved.title: Your review is complete
approved.body: A prescription has been issued where medically appropriate. You can continue to your recommended solution.

notApproved.label: Not approved
notApproved.title: Medical cannabis wasn't found suitable
notApproved.body: Based on the review, a prescription was not issued. This can happen for several reasons. Our team can talk you through the alternatives.

consultation.label: Consultation needed
consultation.title: A short consultation is recommended
consultation.body: The reviewing doctor would like a brief consultation before deciding. Check your email for the next step.

medicalReview.heading: A few things your reviewer needs to know
medicalReview.intro: Medical cannabis is prescription-only. A licensed doctor reviews your information before anything is prescribed.
